comparison.reason: Recorded speed replay is not a predictive speed comparison. Missing independent inputs: brake_force_n, motor_torque_nm, road_gradient_rad. An explicit Phase 8 experiment with initial conditions, model configuration, compatible inputs and documented assumptions is required; none is run by replay.

limitations: Small contiguous window from a trip, not the complete recorded journey.
Raw VED current polarity is unverified. Signed V×I is not labelled discharge or regeneration.
No measured propulsion torque, brake demand or road gradient; predictive speed comparison unavailable.
Battery temperature, instrument uncertainty and channel synchronization are unknown.
Speed-integrated displacement and differentiated acceleration are derived, not GPS measurements.
Generic EV silhouette and fictional landscape do not identify the vehicle or real location.

subset.omitted_columns: GPS and unrelated fuel/engine signals omitted; retained values unchanged
subset.selection_rule: Longest contiguous segment in inspected trip subset, max interval <=2 s, max horizon 120 s; no residual-based selection

upstream.limitation: Current sign inversion inferred but not confirmed from publisher documentation; no battery temperature/propulsion/braking. Not full vehicle validation.

methods.acceleration: Two-neighbour secant (v[i+1]-v[i-1])/(t[i+1]-t[i-1]); one-sided endpoint differences; no smoothing. Irregular timestamps used directly. Missing/gap stencils unavailable; noise may be amplified.
methods.distance: Piecewise-linear measured speed; trapezoidal interval integral. Gap/missing intervals are excluded and unknown, never claimed as zero travel.
methods.energy: Linear sampled-power integration with exact positive/negative zero-crossing splits, only for asserted known polarity and complete V/I/time coverage.
methods.interpolation: Numeric readouts are preceding actual samples with their timestamps. Visual speed is linearly interpolated only across valid adjacent intervals. No gap bridging or extrapolation.
methods.power: Samplewise SI voltage × SI signed current; no polarity inference.

quality.physical_validation: PENDING; Phase 8 INCONCLUSIVE findings are unchanged.

scope: Recorded measurement replay and descriptive analysis; not predictive model validation.

average_speed_ms.definition: Time-weighted trapezoidal mean over the complete window.

distance_m.definition: Trapezoidal speed integral over the complete window; not GPS distance.

electrical_energy_received_wh.definition: Negative discharge-polarity-adjusted electrical power integral; charging, not necessarily regeneration.
electrical_energy_received_wh.unavailable_reason: Current polarity is unverified; signed V×I does not establish discharge or charging.

electrical_energy_used_wh.definition: Positive discharge-polarity-adjusted electrical power integral, with linear zero-crossing splits.
electrical_energy_used_wh.unavailable_reason: Current polarity is unverified; signed V×I does not establish discharge or charging.

known_segment_distance_m.definition: Speed integral only over valid adjacent intervals; excludes unknown travel.

maximum_speed_ms.definition: Maximum available recorded sample, not an estimate of unsampled peak.

minimum_signed_power_w.definition: Minimum sampled electrical power (derived V×I when available, else mapped power); no charging interpretation without polarity.

peak_acceleration_ms2.definition: Maximum finite-difference estimate over available local windows, including endpoints.

peak_deceleration_ms2.definition: Minimum signed finite-difference acceleration; not necessarily negative.

peak_power_magnitude_w.definition: Maximum absolute sampled electrical power, not validated propulsion demand.

peak_signed_power_w.definition: Maximum sampled electrical power (derived V×I when available, else mapped power); no discharge interpretation without polarity.

regenerative_energy_wh.definition: Regeneration-specific received energy requires evidence of the charging source.
regenerative_energy_wh.unavailable_reason: V/I and deceleration alone do not establish the origin of all charging energy.

speed_coverage_s.definition: Duration of adjacent valid speed intervals within the gap limit.
